info.name: Advanced NLP APIs (Matching Score & Learning Roadmap)
info.description:
🎯 **OFFICIAL API COLLECTION** - Advanced NLP features for CV-Job matching and Learning Roadmap generation

✨ **SELF-SUFFICIENT NLP STACK**:
- PhoBERT NER (F1 96%) for Vietnamese skill extraction
- Sentence-BERT (768-dim, paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2) for semantic embeddings
- TF-IDF + cosine similarity for text matching
- Multi-dimensional scoring: skills (40%), experience (30%), education (15%), projects (15%)
- NO mandatory Gemini dependency (optional enhancement only)

📊 **MATCHING SCORE APIs** (5 endpoints):
- Calculate detailed CV-Job match scores with tier system (A/B/C/D)
- Get top candidates for jobs (employer view)
- Get best matching jobs for candidates
- Recalculate scores when job/CV changes

🎓 **LEARNING ROADMAP APIs** (8 endpoints):
- Generate personalized learning paths (2 methods: Standard + RAG-powered)
- Track progress by week/phase
- Get AI-recommended resources from YouTube, GitHub, ChromaDB
- Submit feedback and ratings
- Browse popular public roadmaps

⭐ **RECOMMENDED**: Use RAG-powered roadmap (/learning-roadmap-rag) for real, verifiable resources with credibility metrics

item.name: 🎓 Learning Roadmap
item.description: APIs for generating and managing personalized learning roadmaps. Two methods available: Standard (faster) and RAG-powered (more accurate with real resources).

request.description:
⭐ **RECOMMENDED** - Generate RAG-powered learning roadmap with REAL resources from YouTube, GitHub, and ChromaDB.

**Features:**
- ✅ Real YouTube videos with view counts and ratings
- ✅ Real GitHub projects with stars and language info
- ✅ Credibility metrics (totalResources, averageCredibility, verificationRate)
- ✅ Verifiable URLs for all resources
- ✅ 3-phase learning plan (Foundation → Core → Advanced)
- ✅ 12-week timeline with weekly breakdown
- ✅ AUTO-CALCULATES skill gaps if not already done

**Request Body - SIMPLE (RECOMMENDED):**
```json
{
  "candidateId": "candidate_id_here",
  "jobId": "job_id_here"
}
```
⚠️ **IMPORTANT**: API sẽ TỰ ĐỘNG phân tích skill gaps nếu chưa có. Chỉ cần:
1. Candidate đã có profile đầy đủ (skills, experience, education)
2. Cung cấp candidateId + jobId

**Request Body - FULL (Optional fields):**
```json
{
  "candidateId": "candidate_id_here",
  "jobId": "job_id_here",
  "targetRole": "Full Stack Developer",
  "timeframe": 12,
  "cvData": {
    "skills": [...],
    "experience": [...],
    "currentLevel": "beginner"
  },
  "useRag": true
}
```

**Response includes:**
- phases[]: 3 learning phases with real resources
- credibilityMetrics: { totalResources, averageCredibility, verificationRate }
- estimatedDuration: 12 weeks
- generatedBy: "RAG-powered AI"

**Performance:** 20-30 seconds (fetches real data + auto skill gap analysis)

⚠️ **BACKUP METHOD** - Generate standard learning roadmap (faster but less accurate).

**Use this when:**
- RAG service is unavailable
- Need faster response (5-10 seconds)
- Don't need real resource verification

**Request Body - MINIMUM:**
```json
{
  "targetJobId": "job_id_here"
}
```
OR
```json
{
  "targetRole": "Frontend Developer"
}
```

**Request Body - FULL (Optional):**
```json
{
  "targetJobId": "job_id_here",
  "targetRole": "Full Stack Developer",
  "timeframe": 12,
  "cvData": {
    "skills": [...],
    "experience": [...],
    "education": [...],
    "currentLevel": "beginner"
  }
}
```

**Notes:**
- ✅ Only need `targetJobId` OR `targetRole` (one required)
- ✅ `cvData` is optional - Auto-fetched from CandidateProfile
- ✅ `timeframe` is optional - Default: 12 weeks
- ⚠️ Resources may not be verified
- ⚠️ No credibilityMetrics
